title: formdeck

toolchain.linux_packages: libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev libayatana-appindicator3-dev librsvg2-dev libxdo-dev libssl-dev patchelf rpm gstreamer1.0-plugins-base gstreamer1.0-plugins-good

extras.name: flatpak
extras.linux_packages: libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev libayatana-appindicator3-dev librsvg2-dev libxdo-dev libssl-dev patchelf rpm gstreamer1.0-plugins-base gstreamer1.0-plugins-good flatpak flatpak-builder elfutils
extras.run:
./formdeck install
./formdeck install-desktop
./formdeck desktop build --bundles deb
cp "$(ls src-tauri/target/release/bundle/deb/*.deb | head -1)" src-tauri/flatpak/formdeck.deb
flatpak remote-add --user --if-not-exists flathub https://dl.flathub.org/repo/flathub.flatpakrepo
flatpak install --user -y --noninteractive flathub org.gnome.Platform//47 org.gnome.Sdk//47
cd src-tauri/flatpak
flatpak-builder --user --disable-rofiles-fuse --force-clean --repo=../../flatpak-repo ../../flatpak-build ai.nodemode.formdeck.yml
cd ../..
flatpak build-bundle flatpak-repo formdeck.flatpak ai.nodemode.formdeck

catalog.name: FormSlide
catalog.summary: Presentations: build slides, present and export.

notes_for_owner: The Flatpak was built by a separate job in the gnome-47 flatpak-github-actions container (--privileged) from the linux-x64 deb. The extra has no container or artifact hand-over, so it builds its own deb on ubuntu-24.04 (./formdeck desktop build --bundles deb), then runs flatpak-builder and flatpak build-bundle itself against org.gnome.Platform//47; these flatpak commands are written from the manifest and the action's behaviour, not copied from the old workflow, so run the first release and check formdeck.flatpak. The extra is experimental so a Flatpak failure does not block the release, as before. The updater public key in src-tauri/tauri.conf.json is still empty, so the app skips update checks until a key pair is made and TAURI_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY is set in formcompiler.
